desc: Derive the quadratic formula for \(y\) after setting \(d=x-y\), including the exact discriminant condition.
Design safe integer cube-root and square-root checks that avoid floating-point precision issues.
Verify bounds and complexity for enumerating \(d=1\) through \(\lfloor\sqrt[3]{N}\rfloor\).
Identify edge cases, especially \(N=1\), non-divisible differences, and candidates with \(y\le0\).
Implement the stdin/stdout Python solution using integer arithmetic and final equation verification.
